title: Abhi Microfinance Bank IPO Raises Rs. 2 Billion
excerpt: ABHI Microfinance Bank successfully raises approximately Rs. 2.05 billion via the book-building phase of its initial public offering.
body_html:
ABHI Microfinance Bank secured approximately Rs. 2.05 billion during the book-building segment of its initial public offering (IPO).

The successful fundraising effort followed high demand during the offering process, allowing the bank to reach the milestone figure through the book-building portion of the IPO.
